create_ExperimentFunction: create an ExperimentFunction wrapping a callable with a nevergrad Parameter for benchmarking experiments
copy_ExperimentFunction: copy an ExperimentFunction instance to produce an equivalent instance with fresh random state
create_ArrayExperimentFunction: create an ArrayExperimentFunction with symmetry transformations to generate variant test functions from one base
create_MultiExperiment: create a MultiExperiment packing multiple mono-objective ExperimentFunctions into a multiobjective experiment
update_leaderboard: update a leaderboard CSV file with a new best loss value and corresponding parameter array
